bottleneck.observation: A single gateway /ready request took about 5.34 seconds while the configured vLLM endpoint was unreachable.
bottleneck.analysis: The readiness handler probes dependencies synchronously. The absent optional vLLM endpoint waits for its connection timeout on every request, so concurrency does not remove the roughly five-second latency floor.
recommended_actions: Cache dependency readiness for a short bounded interval.
Use a sub-second timeout or circuit breaker for the optional vLLM probe.
Separate lightweight pod readiness from a deeper dependency diagnostic endpoint.
